sections.title: Ireland and the Atlantic World
sections.description: This course examines Ireland before 1800. It considers it in relation to Europe and the Atlantic world — including the expanding English and later British empire — of which it was sometimes part. We will examine Ireland as a site of colonization (or "plantation") and its involvement in colonial settlement, trade, and empire around the Atlantic from the sixteenth century through the eighteenth centuries.
